data.name: Gloomy Clues: The Broken Mirror
data.detailed_description:
DEVELOPER NOTE: This title has been updated to Gloomy Clues: The Broken Mirror, a Remake Graphic Adventure rebuilt from the ground up. The original hidden object version, Gloomy Clues: Classic Edition 2024, has been moved to a DLC free for original owners to definitively resolve past technical issues.

⚠️ TECHNICAL COMPATIBILITY: This remake is natively optimized for macOS and Linux, offering high performance and a lightweight footprint (approx. 250MB). Please note: due to legacy AppID limitations, Steam Achievements are currently not integrated in the macOS/Linux versions. We have prioritized gameplay stability and performance for this release.

🌐 ADDITIONAL LANGUAGES (BETA): While English and Spanish are natively developed and fully verified, localization for all other available languages is currently in an experimental Beta phase powered by advanced translation technologies. The game is fully playable from start to finish in these languages, and we are continuously refining the text based on player reports.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

THE TRUTH HAS TWO SIDES. YOURS IS BROKEN.

Step back into the shoes of a tormented detective in Gloomy Clues: The Broken Mirror, a complete reconstruction of the original mystery. Immerse yourself in a dark, rain-soaked city where every shadow hides a secret and every character has something to lose.

A renowned musician has been found dead under murky circumstances in the heart of the city. As you dive deeper, you will uncover a web of lies and desperation that threatens to swallow you whole, forcing you to face not only the city’s killers but also the shattered fragments of your own memory.

CORE FEATURES:

  • Instinct and Asphalt: Scour the city of Blackport for crucial evidence. From the decay of Saltmire to the neon glow of the Southlight jazz district, every location is a puzzle where you must combine objects with cold logic to unlock the truth.

  • High-Stakes Interrogations: Engage in tense conversations where silence speaks louder than words. Use empathy, aggression, or cold logic to break suspects in the elite halls of Greyledge or the dark corners of the city, but beware: every choice stains your morality.

  • Psychological Noir Narrative: The city’s darkness isn't your only enemy. Detective Wilder’s past is always lurking, especially within the haunting walls of St. Hope, pushing your psychological state to the limit in a world where nothing is as it seems.

  • The Weight of Justice: Will you deliver redemption, or will the case remain unsolved? Your moral compass and actions dictate the final resolution of this criminal tragedy across multiple endings.

A TRUE REMAKE, BORN FROM THE SHADOWS

This is not a simple coat of paint. It is a total reconstruction in a modern engine, addressing all past limitations to provide the definitive cinematic experience:

  • Redesigned Art Direction: A completely new visual identity with high-contrast lighting designed to fully immerse you in a moody, 1980s noir atmosphere.

  • Modernized Investigation UI: Track your progress with ease. A sleek, redesigned notebook system allows you to manage your clues and objectives intuitively, keeping you focused on the mystery.

  • Enhanced Sound & Music: Let the haunting, melancholic jazz and dark synth soundtrack wrap around you, featuring a fully remastered score and immersive environmental audio.

content_descriptors.notes:
"Gloomy Clues: The Broken Mirror" is a mature investigative thriller featuring a gritty graphic novel aesthetic. Due to its uncompromising narrative and oppressive atmosphere, the following content may not be appropriate for all audiences:

Violence and Crime Scenes: The game features detailed murder investigations depicting corpses, blood, and stylized mutilations. Players will encounter scenes of physical violence, including gunshots and blunt force trauma (e.g., being struck with bottles), which are central to the forensic and detective gameplay.

Adult Themes and Psychological Sensitivity: The narrative explores complex themes of extreme psychological manipulation, mind control, and trauma. It includes suggestive situations, partially undressed characters, and references to power dynamics and restraint (BDSM), conveyed through stylized artwork and mature dialogue.

Substance Use and Strong Language: Consistent with its "Noir" setting, alcohol and drugs play an active role. Players can use alcohol as a tool to coerce Non-Playable Characters (NPCs) into revealing information. The game depicts intoxication, bribery, and the use of strong language reflective of the criminal underworld.

Generative AI Disclosure: Environmental assets and artistic backgrounds were created with the assistance of generative AI, subsequently refined and hand-painted by our team to ensure a unique and cohesive noir atmosphere.

Age Recommendation: Strictly intended for players aged 18 and over.
